notes_for_editor: Existence and location are supported by two lists (Tennessee Land Forms, undated; the 2014 NRHP extant list) and by the community's Wikipedia entry. No build date, builder, crew, staffing or fire history was found after two WebSearch queries. The story is short because the evidence is short. Montgomery County archives or the Tennessee Division of Forestry may hold the history. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this tower is in the crawl cache.
